summary: Barrow County tower listed at 970 ft. A 1995 resolution allowed a lookout site inside Fort Yargo State Park to be leased to the City of Winder as a fire station; it is taken to be this tower, but no source says so outright.

events.note: Georgia House resolution of February 10, 1995 allowed the lookout site, about two acres inside Fort Yargo State Park, to be leased to the City of Winder for use as a fire station.

corrections.why: The list tags this tower gfc-928, a GFC list number. The US prefix in the record has no basis in the source.

notes_for_editor: Identity: the 1995 lease concerns the lookout site on the Forest Lookouts Barrow County page. That page gives no tnlandforms number or height, so the link to GA226 (Barrow, 970, gfc-928) rests on the county and the name. The list coordinates (33.97633, -83.71709) sit about 1.4 km from the park's Wikipedia coordinates (33.969621, -83.729612). That is our own arithmetic, not a source, and it fits the tower lying inside the park. The lookout parcel's present use and whether the tower still stands are unknown. The city page names two stations but no addresses, so no link to the lookout site is made. A Mainstreet News story on Winder fire services was not read (HTTP 429). The registers tag has the same problem as Williams Mountain; see corrections. Confidence medium: one documented 1995 event from one page.
